title: PANTONE® USA | Luo Tianyi x Pantone: How One Blue Captures an Entire Cultural Movement

headings.text: Luo Tianyi x Pantone: How One Blue Captures an Entire Cultural Movement
Luo Tianyi, the world’s first Chinese VOCALOID virtual singer, is widely recognized for two things: her voice and her distinct blue hue.

body_text: August 5, 2026 In a world that's quickly becoming more and more digital, it's easy to assume that genuine connection is harder to come by. But if you're a fan of Luo Tianyi, you know that couldn't be further from the truth. Luo Tianyi, the world’s firstChinese VOCALOID virtual singer, has become a cultural phenomenon through the digital world of entertainment, and a huge reason why is because her fans aren't bound be geographic location, physical proximity, or even the human form. She can be found wherever they are, with the click of a button. Luo Tianyi was first created in 2012 when internet culture was no longer in its infancy but was still booming with innovative technology. And while her voice is the thing that her fans connect with the most, her signature blue color is what best encompasses her fascinating journey to fame. Since her debut, she has grown from ACG (Animation, Comics, and Games) subcultures to mainstream stages likeCCTV’s Spring Festival Galaand theBeijing Winter Olympics, amassing more than ten million followers across digital platforms and surpassing one billion total video views on her officialBilibiliaccount. Originally designed by illustrator ideolo, Luo Tianyi's look "balances translucency and futurism—recalling both water and sky reflections and digital screen glows—and conveys a lighthearted, emotionally accessible warmth rather than cold technological intensity," her team shared. "Over time, fans embraced the chant 'Hua Feng Xia Yun, Luo Shui Tian Yi,（华风夏韵，洛水天依）,” further strengthening the connection between Luo Tianyi and the imagery of flowing water." The color now manifests itself across mediums, many of which are driven by her fans, who remain the true co-creators of her beloved aesthetic. The most popular ritual is known as the “blue lighting sea” at her concerts, where "tens of thousands of people simultaneously switch their glow sticks to blue as her hologram appears," her team continued. "This creates an ocean of light that symbolizes the emotional connection between Luo Tianyi and her fans." To capture this iconic shade, Luo Tianyi's team worked closely with thePantone Color Institute™to create the official Tianyi Blue color. "The blue appears consistently in her costumes, key visuals, stage lighting, and fan glow‑stick colors, forming a unified visual language," her team explained. "In the 2026Pure Blue Fantasyconcert tour, blue becomes the central narrative thread, shifting through various shades to match different musical chapters and emotional moods, such as youth, fantasy, companionship, and romance. This blue universe is further amplified through online‑offline integration with Bilibili and Pantone, including a main key visual and color chip." The partnership created a culturally impactful campaign through music, visuals, and storytelling, giving Luo Tianyi's massive global impact the recognition it deserves. As of June 11, Pantone and Luo Tianyi's official accounts have co-launched 13 social posts on five platforms, generating a total of 1.13M +social exposures and 30K+engagements. Massive interactions also flooded the social media campaign, featuring the hashtags #PANTONEand #LuoTianyi, where fans shared snapshots of capturing the blue out in the world. It's these individual interpretations from fans that make Luo Tianyi so special—and what will continue to carry her legacy from one generation to the next. "Different creators can use her voice to tell different stories, and different fans can find their own emotions, memories, and imagination in those works," her team explained. "But she also has a recognizable identity, now with a signature color." title: PANTONE® USA | Watsons x Pantone: An Evergreen Color 185 Years in the Making

headings.text: Watsons x Pantone: An Evergreen Color 185 Years in the Making

To mark the milestone of 185 years of health and beauty expertise, Watsons partnered with the Pantone Color Institute™ to standardize a single, defining hue: one that tells the story of their long-standing promise through past, present, and future.
The Role of the Pantone Color Institute
Activating in Unison Across Watsons' Global Network

body_text: Alvin Chingcuanco Partnerships Manager July 24, 2026 One hundred and eighty-five years is a long time to own a color. Over that timespan,Watsonshas become part of the everyday fabric of life across Asia: a constant, trusted presence in health, beauty, and well-being. So when the brand partnered with thePantone Color Instituteto mark this anniversary, the question was never which color to pick—it was how to make official what customers had always known. The result is Watsons Evergreen: a vibrant, energizing green with a subtle undertone of blue that speaks to vitality, trust,and an unbroken commitment to the people Watsons serves. More than a brand refresh, it is a declaration. A color with a story, standardized by the global authority on color. The green at the heart of Watsons Evergreen is immediate and alive. It evokes growth, freshness, and the feeling of being at one's best: qualities that sit at the core of what Watsons offers its customers every day. This is color as vitality, as the visual language of wellness. But look closer and Watsons Evergreen reveals a cooler dimension. The hint of blue woven into its character is deliberate and meaningful. It speaks to the integrity that Watsons has built across generations: a sense of reliable, responsible presence that customers, partners, and communities have come to count on. Warmth and trust, held in balance. Then there is the name itself. Evergreen does not simply describe a color; it describes a commitment. One that remains constant through changing seasons, evolving markets, and shifting customer needs. It is the promise of a brand that has endured for nearly two centuries and intends to keep going. "Watsons Evergreen captures the essence of a brand that has stood the test of time while continuing to grow and evolve. It is a color that speaks of vitality and longevity, of a deep, lasting connection to the customers and communities Watsons has served for generations." Watsons engaged the Pantone Color Institute, the world's leading authority on color standards and color psychology, to do what only they can: take an instinct and make it definitive. The Institute's process goes beyond selection. It involves deep examination of what a brand means, how it moves through the world, and what a color must carry on its behalf. For Watsons Evergreen, that meant anchoring the hue in the specific emotional and symbolic territory the brand occupies: everyday vitality, long-held trust, sustainability, and the joy of looking and feeling one's best. Every quality had to be present in the color, in balance, without compromise. The Pantone Color Institute also shaped the narrative around Watsons Evergreen, ensuring that the color and its story would land with coherence and impact across every market where Watsons operates. The result is a color that works as hard as the brand it represents. This landmark collaboration called for a fully co-ordinated, multi-audience activation strategy across 10 participating Watsons markets in order to optimize international exposure for Watsons Evergreen. The strategy leveraged Watsons’ established "O+O" ethos—seamlessly connecting online and offline experiences for its customers to ensure the collaboration was embedded across as many touchpoints and brand pillars as possible, drawing on the full power of Watsons’ physical and digital footprint. Using bricks and mortar stores and ecommerce/social platforms as an "Evergreen canvas," the color was washed abundantly across digital billboards, store fascias, Instagram accounts, homepages, and app screens—creating widespread, high-impact awareness for multiple audiences. For instance, audiences in Taiwan saw a full-scale Evergreen takeover, with the Watsons flagship store wrapped in the signature color. To encourage deeper participation in the collaboration, the "Evergreen Me" activation pillar encouraged audiences to create UG (user generated) content, experiment in stores with collab-specific product curations, and share "what Evergreen means to you"—a question asked of KOCs, store colleagues, pharmacists, and Watsons Club members. To strengthen Watsons’ sustainability commitments, the "Evergreen World" activations pillar included strategic alignments of existing "green" initiatives, like Watsons Indonesia’s Do Good Box and Watsons Taiwan’s member bonus points offers on "green" products. This creates longer-term Evergreen-themed sustainability activations whilst reaffirming customers’ perceptions of Watsons as a responsible retailer. Other activation pillars included "Evergreen Value,"connecting the Watsons x Pantone collaboration with a calendar of themed offers and category promotions—proving to customers that Watsons Evergreen will forever symbolize accessibly priced, high quality health and beauty. What does it mean to be Evergreen? For Watsons, it means always improving, always welcoming, always delivering the authentic quality customers have trusted for nearly two centuries. It means showing up in stores and online, in health and beauty, in the communities that have made Watsons what it is. Watsons Evergreen gives that promise a color. A single, internationally recognized hue that customers anywhere in the world will come to know as a symbol for something reliable, warm, and enduring. A color that says: we are here. We have always been here. And we always will be. Home Articles Case Studies Watsons x Pantone: An Evergreen Color 185 Years in the Making To take advantage of your Pantone member perks,sign in. title: PANTONE® USA | Beetles x Pantone: Where Color Finds Its Meaning

headings.text: Beetles x Pantone: Where Color Finds Its Meaning
Beetles Gel Polish and the language of Nail Glow.
Nail Glow: A Condition, Not a Finish

body_text: Alvin Chingcuanco Partnerships Manager July 13, 2026 Some beauty launches arrive. Others land with intention. TheBeetles Gel PolishNail Glow Collection, co-developed with thePantone Color Institute™, belongs to the second category. It is not a seasonal drop or a trend response. It is a considered act of color design: six shades built from cultural insight outward, each one named, calibrated, and positioned to carry meaning well beyond the moment it enters the market. Beetles Gel Polish approached the Pantone Color Institute with a brief that went beyond product development. The brand wanted a color language: a system of shades with emotional depth, cultural grounding, and the kind of lasting resonance that transforms a nail polish into a signature. Not just a product but a statement. Pantone's trend forecasting gave Beetles the rigorous foundation that brief required. Together, the two brands co-developed the palette from concept to formulation. The timing is deliberate. The dominant shift in color culture right now is not toward spectacle—it is toward intention. Consumers across fashion, interiors, and beauty are reaching for shades that settle rather than shout, that carry emotional logic rather than seasonal novelty. The Nail Glow palette was built directly inside that shift. The collection’s signature name does not refer to shimmer or gloss. Glow, as Beetles defines it, is a condition: the natural state nails reach after being thoughtfully cared for. Clean color. Smooth application. A quiet luminosity that reflects the result of attention, care, and small moments intentionally created for yourself. That philosophy was shaped by research. Through interviews with more than 100 nail users, Beetles uncovered a consistent insight: doing your nails is often about far more than aesthetics. For many consumers, it creates a sense of order, calm, confidence, and personal control within busy lives. It becomes a ritual—one that offers emotional reset alongside self-expression. That understanding became the foundation for Nail Glow. Working alongside Pantone Color Institute, Beetles translated those emotional insights into an intentionally curated color experience—developing shades designed not only to look beautiful, but to support the feelings consumers increasingly seek from beauty rituals today. Each color was selected through the lens of trend intelligence, emotional connection, and modern self-expression, helping transform Nail Glow from a polish collection into a more thoughtful daily ritual. Six shades. Distinct in personality. Unified in purpose. The Nail Glow palette was intentionally developed to move between warmth and calm, softness and optimism, grounding and lightness, giving consumers colors that feel emotionally relevant while remaining effortlessly wearable. A smoky pink-brown neutral designed to create a feeling of grounding and pause. Inspired by the growing consumer movement toward comfort-driven color palettes, it brings quiet sophistication into everyday routines. A warm golden amber that reflects optimism, comfort, and indulgent simplicity. Rich without excess, it captures the cultural return toward warmth and emotionally uplifting tones across beauty and design. A soft pink-neutral designed to feel calming, balanced, and understated. Minimal yet elevated, it reflects the continued movement toward intentional simplicity and effortless beauty. An expressive pink that introduces lightness and positivity into the collection. Playful without feeling loud, energetic without overwhelming—designed to bring moments of joy into everyday rituals. A creamy off-white inspired by comfort, softness, and modern minimalism. Clean and versatile, it transforms simplicity into something restorative and elevated. The collection’s hero shade. The portmanteau of meditative and sedative perfectly captures the state of deep, calming relaxation. A soft atmospheric blue intentionally developed around growing cultural shifts toward calm, clarity, and understated self-expression. Pantone’s trend intelligence identified increasing consumer appetite for colors that feel steadying rather than overstimulating—shades that create visual breathing room while remaining modern and wearable. Medative State answers that shift directly. Balanced across skin tones and designed for everyday versatility, the shade embodies the larger Nail Glow philosophy: beauty not simply as appearance, but as a feeling. Each shade is delivered through a formula that matches the collection's ambition: a smooth, self-leveling gel with full pigmentation in a single coat, scratch-resistant wear lasting over 21 days, and a 60-second cure time. HEMA-free and developed for frequent use, with a C-curve fiber brush engineered for precision along the natural nail contour. What distinguishes Nail Glow within the current beauty landscape is not the Pantone partnership alone. It is what that partnership made possible: a coherent color system where names, shades, and emotional intentions all speak in the same voice. The brands gaining ground in beauty right now are treating color the way a designer treats a collection. Not as a sequence of individual products, but as a considered point of view. A palette with narrative structure. Shades that reference each other. Colors that accumulate meaning over time rather than cycling with the season. Beetles has built exactly that. The Nail Glow Collection is designed to reach beyond the brand's traditional customer base and connect with a wider cultural audience: lifestyle consumers, trend-conscious creators, nail professionals, and a Gen Z community that engages with color as cultural expression, not just finishing touch. Nail Glow is not a product launch dressed as a collaboration. It is a strategic repositioning expressed through color. Beetles enters this collection as a brand that understands what color can carry when it is built with rigor: identity, emotion, memory, and the quiet pleasure of a ritual that returns you to yourself. Some collections reflect the moment. This one is designed to outlast it. title: PANTONE® USA | Where Color Finds Its Flow: Living the Palette of Greater Fort Lauderdale

headings.text: Where Color Finds Its Flow: Living the Palette of Greater Fort Lauderdale
The Morning Light of the Atlantic
Where the Water Sets the Rhythm
When the Day Slips Into Evening
The Joy That Finds You Here

body_text: Kim Sterling Head of Strategic Marketing Partnerships June 1, 2026 There are places you visit. And there are places that move you. GreaterFort Lauderdalebelongs to the latter—a destination where water sets the rhythm, color shapes the mood, and every moment feels like it’s unfolding inside a living palette. Here, the day doesn’t simply begin. Itemerges in color. Just before sunrise, the horizon glows with coral warmth,PANTONERadiant Sunrise, spilling across the Atlantic Ocean as early walkers trace the shoreline along the 24 miles of golden beaches. Paddleboarders drift along the Intracoastal while, at the ocean’s edge, early risers stand with toes in the water, taking in the gentle motion of the waves. It’s the kind of morning that feels suspended in time—when the air is cool, the sky is wide open, and the day feels full of possibility. As the sun rises higher, the landscape softens intoPANTONEMorning Glow,the golden warmth that settles across cafés and waterfront patios. On Las Olas Boulevard, Fort Lauderdale begins to wake. Espresso machines hum as galleries and boutiques open their doors, olive trees line the median, and the New River flows just beyond, weaving through the city. Travelers linger over breakfast, surrounded by art, history, and the easy pace of the morning. In Greater Fort Lauderdale, the answer is almost always the same. Toward the water. Because here, the beach is just the beginning. More than 300 miles of inland waterways connect neighborhoods, marinas, sandbars, and hidden corners of the destination, creating a place where movement happens naturally by boat, kayak, paddleboard, or water taxi. Here, the day unfolds along the water—from morning swims in the Atlantic to afternoon rides along the Intracoastal. By midday, the palette shifts into the blues that define the destination. The sky sharpens intoPANTONENautical Breeze,stretching wide above cruise ships leaving Port Everglades and parasails drifting above the shoreline. Along the Intracoastal, the water deepens intoPANTONELauderTeal, reflecting waterfront homes, passing yachts and fishing boats, as water taxis move between stops. Further out, sandbars fill with boats anchored for the afternoon—music drifting across the water, friends moving in and out of the water between conversations. Closer to shore, waves scatter pale ribbons ofPANTONESeafoamandPANTONEOcean Mist, the colors of salt spray and soft tides that seem to quiet everything around them. It’s here that the destination reveals its true nature. Relaxed. Connected. Effortlessly alive. Greater Fort Lauderdale rewards curiosity. Follow the waterways inland and the landscape transforms. Mangrove forests ripple through quiet estuaries at West Lake Park, just inland from the beach. Airboats skim across the sawgrass of the Everglades. Cyclists wind along shaded paths through Hugh Taylor Birch State Park. Even the streets across Greater Fort Lauderdale carry their own rhythm. Afternoons might unfold in the Thrive Arts District exploring galleries and murals, or browsing along Las Olas Boulevard where art spaces, wine bars, and local boutiques create a neighborhood that feels both creative and coastal. Here, exploration feels natural, with beaches, waterways, neighborhoods, and culture all flowing together within minutes of one another. As sunset approaches, the palette shifts again. Warm reflections settle across the shoreline in tones ofPANTONESandbarandPANTONE Golden Shore, the colors of sun-warmed beaches and quiet evening walks. Along the Hollywood Beach Broadwalk, the energy picks up—live music drifts from beachfront spots, restaurants fill with conversation, and cyclists and walkers move steadily along the shoreline as the sky softens into evening. Later, Las Olas begins to glow—rooftop terraces filling with conversation, waterfront restaurants lighting candles beside the canal, and music drifting into the warm night air. Reflections shimmer across the water like liquid neon. It’s vibrant without feeling overwhelming. Energetic without losing its ease. A destination confident enough to move at its own pace. What makes Greater Fort Lauderdale unforgettable isn’t just its scenery. It’s the way the destination reconnects people with something they didn’t realize they were missing. The freedom of moving from beach to canal to café without ever leaving the breeze behind. The joy of jumping off the back of a boat at a sandbar. The quiet calm of watching the sunrise over the Atlantic. Each color in the Greater Fort Lauderdale palette captures a piece of that experience—the warmth of sunlight, the movement of water, the grounding calm of nature, and the spontaneous energy that fills the air. Because here, color is expression. It’s memory. It’s the feeling that returns the moment you step into the water. And once you feel it, you remember something simple: some places bring out a version of you that feels lighter, freer, more alive. In Greater Fort Lauderdale, that feeling has a way of staying with you—the kind that reminds you tonever lose your splash.
